audit_scope: Read-only independent comparison of existing artifacts; no tests or production/model/GPU actions executed by this audit. Only this new evidence file was created.
interpretation: All 203 original failed/error nodeIDs have at least one later completed passing observation in the eight focused invocations listed here.
This is a deduplicated coverage audit, not a newly passing whole suite. The original full run remains 4182 passed, 185 failed, and 18 errors.
Some nodes failed more than once before passing. Failed observations are preserved in their original logs and in the focused evidence catalog; only later passing observations count toward coverage.

Focused runs span differing source revisions, fixture fixes, and isolated guard versions. Reported git HEAD alone is not proof that all runs used one identical clean source tree; source snapshots are linked where available.

Quiet pytest logs require explicit-target minus exact-failure-footer attribution for early groups, validated against completed terminal counts. The remaining CPU group has exact JUnit evidence and the isolated two-test group records call outcomes.

The earlier 5-pass stale-test repair receipt is redundant for this union because its two original failing nodes have later completed passing evidence in excluded_and_timing; it is not added as five original-node passes.
Offline engineering passes do not change real GPU campaign success rates, fixed-nine acceptance, model costs, or public/live operation status.
